note_en: 离婚 "get divorced" is a verb-object compound (离 "leave" + 婚 "marriage"), so it can't take another object: you don't say 离婚她 for "divorce her." Chinese says 跟她离婚, or simply 他们离婚了 "they got divorced," and in this text the two partners are just the subject: 双方都还愿意离婚 "both still want to divorce." The same goes for 结婚 "marry": 和他结婚, never 结婚他.
